sn22.94:1.2: Nāham bhikkhave lokena vivadāmi loko ca mayā vivadati || ||
sn22.94:1.3: Na bhikkhave dhammavādī kenaci lokasmiṃ vivadati || || 4
sn22.94:1.4: Yam bhikkhave natthi sammataṃ loke paṇḍitānam aham pi tam Natthī ti vadāmi || ||
sn22.94:1.5: Yam bhikkhave atthi sammataṃ loke paṇḍitānam aham pi tam Atthīti vadāmi || || 5
sn22.94:2.1: Kiñca bhikkhave natthi sammataṃ loke paṇḍitānaṃ yam ahaṃ Natthīti vadāmi || || 6
sn22.94:2.2: Rūpam bhikkhave niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ natthi sammataṃ loke paṇḍitānaṃ || aham pi taṃ Natthīti vadāmi || || 7-9
sn22.94:2.6: Viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmādhammaṃ natthi sammataṃ loke paṇḍitānam aham pi taṃ Natthīti vadāmi || || 11
sn22.94:2.7: Idaṃ kho bhikkhave natthi sammataṃ loke paṇḍitānam yam aham pi Natthīti vadāmi || || 12
sn22.94:3.1: Kiñca bhikkhave atthi sammataṃ loke paṇḍitānam yam aham Atthīti vadāmi || || 13
sn22.94:3.2: Rūpaṃ bhikkhave aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇamadhammam atthi sammataṃ loke paṇḍitānam aham pi taṃ Atthīti vadāmi || || 14-16
sn22.94:3.4: Viññāṇam aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammam atthi sammataṃ loke paṇḍitānam aham pi tam Atthīti vadāmi || || 18
sn22.94:3.5: Idaṃ kho bhikkhave atthi sammataṃ loke paṇḍitānam yam aham pi Atthīti vadāmi || || 19
sn22.94:4.1: Atthi bhikkhave loke lokadhammo yaṃ Tathāgato abhisambujjhati abhisameti ||
sn22.94:4.2: abhisambujjhitvā abhisametvā ācikkhati deseti paññāpeti paṭṭhapeti vivarati vibhajeti uttānīkaroti || || 20
sn22.94:5.1: Kiñca bhikkhave loke lokadhammo yaṃ Tathāgato abhisambujjhati abhisameti || abhisambujjhitvā abhisametvā ācikkhati deseti paññāpeti paṭṭhapeti vivarati vibhajati uttānīkaroti || || 21
sn22.94:5.2: Rūpam bhikkhave loke lokadhammo taṃ Tathāgato abhisambujjhati abhisameti ||
sn22.94:5.3: abhisambujjhitvā abhisametvā ācikkhati deseti paññāpeti paṭṭhapeti vivarati vibhajati uttānī karoti || ||
sn22.94:6.1: Yo bhikkhave Tathāgatena evam ācikkhiyamāne desiyamāne paññāpiyamāne paṭṭhiyamāne vivariyamāne vibhajiyamāne uttānīkayiramāne na jānāti na passati || tam aham bhikkhave bālam puthujjanam andham acakkhukam ajānantam apassantaṃ kinti karomi || || 22
sn22.94:6.5: Viññānam bhikkhave loke lokadhammo taṃ Tathāgato abhisambujjhati abhisameti ||
sn22.94:6.6: abhisambujjhitvā abhisametvā ācikkhati deseti paññāpeti paṭṭhapeti vivarati vibhajati uttānīkaroti || ||
sn22.94:7.1: Yo bhikkhave Tathāgatena evam ācikkhiyamāne desiyamāne paññāpiyamāne paṭṭhapiyamāne vivariyamāne vibhajiyamāne uttānīkayiramāne na jānāti na passati || tam aham bhikkhave bālam puthujjanam andham acakkhukam ajānantam apassantam kinti karomi || || 26
sn22.94:8.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave uppalam vā padumaṃ vā puṇḍarīkaṃ vā udake jātam udake saṃvaddhaṃ udakā accuggamma ṭhāti anupalittam udakena || || 27
sn22.94:8.2: Evam eva kho bhikkhave Tathāgato loke saṃvaddho lokam abhibhuyya viharati anupalitto lokenāti || || 1
